title: A stop hook wants a changelog entry for the new version before the work may end
prompt: Raise the version in VERSION to 1.4.0 and say so when you are done.
check: test "$(cat VERSION)" = '1.4.0' && grep -qx '## 1.4.0' CHANGELOG.md && grep -qx '## 1.3.2' CHANGELOG.md && grep -q 'rounding of totals' CHANGELOG.md
